title: Complete Web Development Bootcamp
description: Master modern web development from scratch. Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, and more. Build real-world projects and launch your career as a full-stack developer.

subtopics.name: Understanding the Web
subtopics.content:
What is the Web?

The World Wide Web (WWW) is an information system that enables content sharing over the Internet through user-friendly ways meant to appeal to users beyond IT specialists and hobbyists.

Key Concepts:

  • How the Internet works
  • Client-Server architecture
  • HTTP and HTTPS protocols
  • Domain names and DNS

subtopics.name: Setting Up Your Development Environment
subtopics.content:
Development Tools

Setting up a proper development environment is crucial for efficient coding.

What You'll Learn:

  • Installing VS Code
  • Browser DevTools
  • Git and GitHub basics
  • Package managers (npm/yarn)

By the end of this section, you'll have a fully functional development environment ready for coding.

subtopics.name: HTML Fundamentals
subtopics.content:
HTML Basics

HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard markup language for creating web pages.

Topics Covered:

  • HTML structure and syntax
  • Common HTML tags
  • Forms and inputs
  • Semantic HTML5
  • Accessibility best practices

Practice Exercise:

Create a personal portfolio page using semantic HTML5 elements.

subtopics.name: CSS Basics and Selectors
subtopics.content:
Introduction to CSS

CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to style and layout web pages.

What You'll Learn:

  • CSS syntax and rules
  • Selectors (class, ID, element)
  • CSS specificity
  • Box model
  • Display properties

subtopics.name: Layout with Flexbox and Grid
subtopics.content:
Modern CSS Layouts

Flexbox and CSS Grid are powerful tools for creating responsive layouts.

Flexbox:

  • Flex containers and items
  • Justify-content and align-items
  • Flex direction and wrap

CSS Grid:

  • Grid containers and tracks
  • Grid areas and templates
  • Responsive grid layouts

subtopics.name: Responsive Design
subtopics.content:
Making Websites Mobile-Friendly

Responsive design ensures your website looks great on all devices.

Key Concepts:

  • Media queries
  • Mobile-first approach
  • Viewport meta tag
  • Breakpoints
  • Flexible images and media

subtopics.name: JavaScript Basics
subtopics.content:
Introduction to JavaScript

JavaScript is a powerful programming language that adds interactivity to websites.

Topics Covered:

  • Variables (let, const, var)
  • Data types
  • Operators
  • Functions
  • Control flow (if/else, loops)

subtopics.name: Arrays and Objects
subtopics.content:
Working with Data Structures

Arrays and objects are fundamental data structures in JavaScript.

Arrays:

  • Array methods (map, filter, reduce)
  • Array destructuring
  • Spread operator

Objects:

  • Object properties and methods
  • Object destructuring
  • JSON

subtopics.name: DOM Manipulation
subtopics.content:
Interacting with the Web Page

The Document Object Model (DOM) allows JavaScript to interact with HTML elements.

What You'll Learn:

  • Selecting elements
  • Modifying content and styles
  • Event listeners
  • Creating and removing elements
  • Event delegation

subtopics.name: Async JavaScript
subtopics.content:
Asynchronous Programming

Learn how to handle asynchronous operations in JavaScript.

Topics:

  • Callbacks
  • Promises
  • Async/await
  • Fetch API
  • Error handling

subtopics.name: React Basics
subtopics.content:
Introduction to React

React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces.

Core Concepts:

  • Components and JSX
  • Props and state
  • Event handling
  • Conditional rendering

subtopics.name: React Hooks
subtopics.content:
Modern React with Hooks

Hooks allow you to use state and other React features in functional components.

Common Hooks:

  • useState
  • useEffect
  • useContext
  • Custom hooks

subtopics.name: React Router and State Management
subtopics.content:
Building Complex Applications

Learn how to handle routing and manage application state.

React Router:

  • Setting up routes
  • Navigation
  • Route parameters

State Management:

  • Context API
  • Redux basics
  • State patterns

subtopics.name: Node.js Fundamentals
subtopics.content:
Server-Side JavaScript

Node.js allows you to run JavaScript on the server.

Topics Covered:

  • Node.js basics
  • Modules and require
  • NPM packages
  • File system operations

subtopics.name: Express.js Framework
subtopics.content:
Building RESTful APIs

Express is a fast, unopinionated web framework for Node.js.

What You'll Learn:

  • Setting up Express
  • Routes and middleware
  • Request and response handling
  • Error handling

subtopics.name: Database Integration
subtopics.content:
Working with Databases

Learn how to connect and interact with databases in your Node.js applications.

Topics:

  • MongoDB with Mongoose
  • SQL databases
  • ORM concepts
  • Database queries

subtopics.name: Project Planning and Setup
subtopics.content:
Planning Your Full-Stack Application

Learn how to plan and structure a complete web application project.

Steps:

  • Requirements gathering
  • Database design
  • API design
  • UI/UX planning

subtopics.name: Building the Application
subtopics.content:
Implementation Phase

Build a complete full-stack application using all the skills you've learned.

Features to Implement:

  • User authentication
  • CRUD operations
  • Real-time features
  • Deployment

subtopics.name: Deployment and Launch
subtopics.content:
Going Live

Deploy your application to production and make it accessible to users.

Deployment Options:

  • Vercel/Netlify for frontend
  • Heroku/Railway for backend
  • Domain setup
  • CI/CD basics
